notable_absence.finding: No privilege, role, or edition gating anywhere - this is a pure how-to guide combining a reused SQL++ concept (PREPARE/EXECUTE, named/positional parameters) with per-access-surface instructions (cbq shell, Data API, Query tab) and per-SDK code tabs (.NET/Java/Node.js/Python). Confirms the round hypothesis for this file: no new SQL++-level concept is revealed, only a new cross-surface/cross-SDK presentation of already-minted n1ql: concepts.

cross_component_finding: This page is the clearest single confirmation in the batch that capella:query-tab, capella:data-api, and n1ql:cbq are genuinely parallel access surfaces for the same underlying feature (supplying placeholder parameter values) - all three are given side-by-side instructions for the identical task, extending the incompatibleWithAccessSurface-adjacent access-surface family already established in n1ql/n1ql-language-reference/transactions.json (round 5) with positive (fully-supported, no exclusion) rather than negative (excluded) evidence.
cross_product_finding: Every per-SDK code tab (.NET, Java, Node.js, Python) demonstrates the identical two-step pattern - bind a parameter value via a QueryOptions method, then set adhoc/AdHoc to false to reuse a cached plan - using different method names (`Parameter`, `parameters`, `parameters` property, `positional_parameters`/`named_parameters`) for what is a single underlying SQL++ PREPARE/EXECUTE mechanism. This is a genuine one-concept/many-vocabularies case (mirrors the CAS/ETag finding from cloud/data-api-guide/data-api-use.json in round 6) worth flagging for reconciliation: sdk:query-options-parameter and sdk:adhoc-query-option are single minted concepts standing in for what could eventually be per-SDK method-name variants if a future round finds SDK-specific behavioral differences.
